bob_customer: Hey team — our invoice for Mar 4 shows ~24,300 embedding units billed but the dashboard/usage page shows ~12,150 for the same account. This started after we ran a bulk rerank+embed job yesterday. Can you help reconcile? cc @alice_support

alice_support: Thanks for the ping. Can you share the request_id / sample request payload and the CSV manifest you used? Short logs are fine. Will triage. :mag:

bob_customer: request_id: r-0a1b2c3d4e5f
bob_customer: Sample payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "embed-lite-001",
  "inputs": ["doc1 text...", "doc2 text...", "doc3 text..."],
  "pairwise": true,
  "batching": {"max_size": 512}
}
```
Note we used our rerank pipeline which also calls embeddings in the same job.

alice_support: Got it. Two quick asks: (1) did you call the embeddings endpoint directly or through the rerank/async wrapper? (2) can you paste the first 8 chars of the full request id?

bob_customer: We call our internal rerank service which fans out: it POSTs to /v1/rerank then to /v1/embeddings (same job). Request id prefix: r-0a1b2c3d.

charlie_eng: jumping in — thanks for the details. Preliminary theory: the job mixed single-embed calls and a pairwise flag got propagated into the batch that the metering pipeline interpreted as "pairwise accounting". Pairwise changes accounting from N to N*(N-1)/2 for a single request. Example from prod logs for your req: 
```
metering_event: request_id=r-0a1b2c3d4e5f type=embed inputs=100 pairwise=true billed_vectors=4950
metering_event: request_id=r-0a1b2c3d4e5f dims=1536 quantized=false
```
That would explain ~50x increase on that request slice.

alice_support: Can you confirm whether your manifest sometimes batches queries+documents together (mixed shapes)? If the batch contains both query/document pairs and independent docs and pairwise is true, the metering path currently applied pairwise to the whole batch.

bob_customer: Yes — our manifest had mixed rows: some rows were "query" entries (for rerank) and others were plain docs. We assumed the embeddings sub-call would only bill per-doc, not per-pair across the whole batch.

charlie_eng: Ok that matches. Short repro we ran locally:
```bash
# reproduce bad path
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"embed-lite-001","inputs":["q1","d1","d2","d3"],"pairwise":true}'
# metering logs then show pairwise=true -> counted as pairs across all inputs
```

charlie_eng: Fix options:
- Short term: set "pairwise": false when calling embeddings directly (or split queries vs docs into separate requests).
- Medium: don't mix query rows and doc rows in the same batch.
- Back-end mitigation: I've opened ENG-4938 to reject mixed-mode batches and ensure `pairwise` only applies when input shape matches expected pairwise contract.

alice_support: For billing, I've escalated to finance. We can scope credits for the clearly overbilled batches while we patch. Can you confirm the date/time window for the bulk job?

bob_customer: Job ran 2026-03-04 03:12:xx UTC -> 03:25:xx UTC. We estimate ~98k inputs across multiple batched requests.

billing-bot: Invoice adjustment created: ADJ-2026-0334 (linked to invoice INV-2026-087)
billing-bot: Credit amount: $2,320.00 — pending approval by finance ops. :money_with_wings:

alice_support: I've attached a short repro checklist for you to avoid this (will paste here):
1) Ensure rerank and embeddings steps are separate RPC calls OR ensure `pairwise` is only set during rerank calls.
2) Avoid mixing query/document rows in a single embeddings batch.
3) On SDKs older than v1.14.0, `pairwise` might be implicitly forwarded — upgrade recommended.

dana_sre: Deployment note: added a server-side validation rule to reject batches that contain both `query` and `document` typed rows with `pairwise=true`. Rollout started to staging, will hit prod in next canary (ENG-4938).

bob_customer: Thanks all — confirmed we split the job and re-ran a small sample with `pairwise:false` -> dashboard count now matches expected. Also saw the credit show up in billing portal. :white_check_mark:

alice_support: Great. We will follow up once ENG-4938 lands and when finance approves final adjustment. Closing ticket as "triaged & patching" for now. If you see any other anomalies, ping me directly.

bob_customer: Appreciate the quick response. Leaving this thread in case others hit it. :pray:
